content: ServerChan Turbo (sct.ftqq.com, fetched 2026-08): SaaS WeChat-ecosystem push. POST https://sctapi.ftqq.com/<SENDKEY>.send with title (required, 32 chars max), desp (markdown up to 32KB), short, channel param. Free tier: 5 msgs/day, title-only display, 1-day retention; paid near-unlimited (1000 API calls/day), full content, 3-day retention. Channels: WeCom Work app msg, WeChat service account templates, DingTalk/Feishu group bots, Bark, custom webhooks; same request routed by console channel config. Message list web page. 2000+ OSS integrations. No two-way. Next-gen ServerChan3 at sc3.ft07.com, keys incompatible.
